context.p: Templates are predesigned diagrams that provide a starting layout for different types of diagrams. draw.io provides a variety of templates. You can also select a blank diagram to create a diagram from scratch.

When you select a template, you can enter a name for the diagram. The diagram is saved in the draw.io XML format by default. This is the editable format that you can use to continue editing the diagram in draw.io.

step.cmd: On the draw.io editor, click File in the upper-left corner.
In the dialog box, do one of the following:

ul.li: To create a diagram from scratch, click Blank Diagram.
To use a template, select the required template. For example, select Flowchart.

step.cmd: Next to Diagram Name, enter the name of the diagram.

taskbody.result: The draw.io editor opens with the selected template. If you entered a diagram name, the name appears in the upper-left corner of the canvas.
